title: The Murder Weapon
description: A marble bust of Apollo, smashed. Blood and hair on the base. The pedestal in the library is empty.
hint: Ask anyone how Victor was killed.

title: The Glove
description: A man's leather glove, monogrammed M.C., found on the garden path beneath the library window. Marble dust in the cuff.
hint: Ask about the garden or the window.

title: The Ledger
description: Marcus's laptop, still open: four shell-company transfers totalling $4.1M, the last one dated yesterday.
hint: Ask Marcus about money or the company books.

title: The Divorce File
description: Evelyn's attorney's draft: Victor was divorcing her. The prenup pays her $0 if infidelity is proven. Dated two weeks ago.
hint: Ask Evelyn about her marriage or the will.

title: The Locket
description: Evelyn's diamond locket, found under the library sofa. Nora's prints are on the service door.
hint: Ask Nora why she was in the library.

title: The Summons
description: Victor's phone: at 11:12 PM he texted Marcus, 'Meet me in the library. Now.' He had called his lawyer at 11:05 PM about 'embezzlement evidence'.
hint: Ask about Victor's phone or the lawyer.

title: The Misdiagnosis
description: A file from Dr Whitfield's practice: Victor's arrhythmia recorded as anxiety two years ago. A $2M malpractice exposure - and a gambling debt of $200K.
hint: Ask Dr Whitfield about Victor's health.

title: The Garden Door
description: The garden door was unlocked from inside. A neighbour's security cam at 11:38 PM shows a tall figure in a grey suit leaving the library - barely 20 metres from the door.
hint: Ask Nora about cameras or what she saw.
